source: Elections Canada, Federal Electoral District boundaries (2023 Representation Order)
notes: 343 districts. Clipped to the Statistics Canada 2021 cartographic province outline (see provinces.topo.meta.json) so coastlines match the province map, islands under 2 km² (or 0.2% of their district) dropped, simplified with mapshaper (weighted Visvalingam with keep-shapes, at an interval scaled to each district's size: 80 m for the smallest urban districts up to 6 km in the North), reprojected to WGS84, quantized to 1e5.

properties.fed: federal electoral district number (ED_CF_NUM); the first two digits are the PRUID
